translation: Not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat wind-pathogen, chronic thirst, vomiting, fullness of both hypochondria, wind-pain, dizziness, and itching of the eyes. It may be made into a plaster and facial ointment that moistens the complexion. One name is 白, one name is , one name is 莞, one name is 苻蘺, one name is 澤芬.
